session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Late Bull Reversal in TR Day' — filename said 'wedge-top-and-then-wedge-bottom-in-TR-Day' (= trading_range in the title map, agreement). Plain-PT axis 3/18 to 3/19 edge marker. Reading: sell-off spike to 2455 at 07:25 (magenta wedge top trendline) flipped the day into a bear channel with sell-offred-box entries around the EMA all morning; the orange dotted open-of-day line (2354) and bottom target (2266) framed the TR; the afternoon measured move from the high to the open expected a test of the open, which the magenta wedge-bottom rally at 12:05-12:25 delivered (failed punt at 2350), and the HL MTR/HSB after the wedge bottom (12:40) drove the late bull reversal to 2410.
